# Question 5








```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Example data
forest <- rep(c("Boreal", "Temperate", "Tropical"), each = 20)
microbes <- rep(seq(0, 10, length.out = 20), 3)

# Create linear model predictions
beta0 <- 4; beta1 <- 3; beta2 <- 6
beta3 <- 0.2; beta4 <- 0.3; beta5 <- 0.5

decomp <- with(data.frame(forest, microbes),
               ifelse(forest == "Boreal", beta0 + beta3 * microbes,
               ifelse(forest == "Temperate", beta0 + beta1 + (beta3 + beta4) * microbes,
                                         beta0 + beta2 + (beta3 + beta5) * microbes)))

# Plot
ggplot(data.frame(forest, microbes, decomp),
       aes(x = microbes, y = decomp, color = forest)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Decomposition Rate ~ Forest Type × Microbes",
       x = "Microbial Abundance",
       y = "Predicted Decomposition Rate") +
  theme_minimal()

```
